signature.name: VTask.biUnionTagged
signature.type: {ι : Type u_1} -> {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι} -> (π : BoxIntegral.Prepartition I) -> (πi : (J : BoxIntegral.Box ι) → BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition J) -> BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition I

conventions.statement: The family πi is accepted for all boxes of type BoxIntegral.Box ι; values at boxes not in π are ignored and do not influence the result.
conventions.note: Lean requires a total function; junk values outside π are harmless.

conventions.statement: The tag of a box K in the output is taken from (πi J).tag K, where J is the unique box in π that contains K as determined by the biUnionIndex function; if K does not belong to any J in π (a degenerate case), the index falls back to a default box, but K itself would not be a member of the result.
conventions.note: This is a structural convention of biUnionIndex: it returns a canonical default when the box is not found.

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι} (π : BoxIntegral.Prepartition I) (πi : (J : BoxIntegral.Box ι) → BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition J) (K : BoxIntegral.Box ι), K ∈ VTask.biUnionTagged π πi → (VTask.biUnionTagged π πi).tag K ∈ BoxIntegral.Box.Icc I

facts.statement: ∀ {ι : Type*} {I : BoxIntegral.Box ι} (π : BoxIntegral.Prepartition I) (πi : (J : BoxIntegral.Box ι) → BoxIntegral.TaggedPrepartition J), π.IsPartition → (∀ J ∈ π, (πi J).IsPartition) → (VTask.biUnionTagged π πi).IsPartition
